expectedResults: Every result identifies its evidence source; automated behavior meets explicit-play and truthful-stop rules; unexecuted physical observations remain open rather than inferred.

steps: Run deterministic host and renderer checks, inspect supported simulator behavior, and collect separately labeled physical-device observations for listening, route, interruption, latency, endurance, energy, thermal, and accessibility conditions.
title: Audible playback evidence and failure-containment matrix
